ValidationRule.description: when recovery type = Cover Refund, Monetary Value Refund Currency and Description fields are required
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', ISPICKVAL( Type__c , 'Cover Refund'), OR( ISBLANK(Monetary_Value__c), ISPICKVAL(Original_Currency__c,''),ISBLANK(Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete the field Monetary Value, Refund Currency and Description
